decision.observed_event: You declare: "'You don't have to take my word. But I'd hate to tell her you turned away her guest.' [Persuasion: I rolled 1 + 10 = 11]"

appraisal.label: concern
appraisal.cause: A veiled threat in Harria's name, poorly delivered.

improv_read.player_bid: Sela threatens to report the dealer to Harria; her Persuasion roll is low.
improv_read.connection: Uktarl wants Harria gone; a threat in her name pushes him to prove his own authority, which the low roll fails to shake.
improv_read.kit_choice: Kit shows the failed persuasion as the dealer hardening and finally demanding the toll as an exchange.

public_brief.objective: Call the threat and turn it back into payment on his terms.
public_brief.tactic: Dare her to carry tales to Harria, then name the toll as a custom of the dead with a cold edge.
public_brief.visible_cue: The smile holds while his eyes go flat; the fresco-side player leans over his coins.
public_brief.player_opening: She can pay, haggle, refuse, or try another angle.
public_brief.reply_to: I'd hate to tell her you turned away her guest.
public_brief.kit_focus: Let the threat fail visibly through the table closing ranks, with no narrator explanation of why.
public_brief.mirror: steady energy, standard, no humor: the table turns cold

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: The dealer's smile stays exactly where it is, but his eyes go flat. The fresco-side player leans forward over his coins, and the fourth player stops tapping the table.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: Tell her, then. Tell Harria whatever pleases you, my lady, and see how far her name carries down here. This road belongs to the dead, and the dead keep their own accounts: ten gold a head to walk it in peace, whoever you dine with at the well. Pay it, and you are my guest. Do not, and you are only a rumor I have not decided about yet.

segments.speaker: Kit
segments.reacts_to: ten gold a head to walk it in peace
